plugins.name: Gratis Backup
plugins.reviewNotes: 2,179 LOC stream-first backup & restore engine with PathGuard, SHA-256 verification, SQLite backup API, and 17-assertion restore self-check. All src/ files ABSPATH-guarded.

plugins.name: Gratis Mail
plugins.reviewNotes: Clean SMTP mailer with OpenSSL/salt-encrypted credentials, test email form, delivery log, and WP-CLI.

plugins.name: Gratis Social
plugins.reviewNotes: Zero-tracking share buttons (inline, floating, shortcode) with clean settings and no third-party JS SDK.

plugins.name: Gratis Reviews
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible star ratings, testimonial grids, review submission form, and Schema.org AggregateRating markup.

plugins.name: Gratis Analytics
plugins.reviewNotes: Cookie-free privacy-first analytics with daily-rotating salted hashes, DNT support, retention pruning, and WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping (reduced from 7 PCP warnings to 0).

plugins.name: Gratis Comply
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2, script gating, privacy policy generator, hashed consent log, and rate-limited GDPR data-request REST endpoint.

plugins.name: Gratis Forms
plugins.reviewNotes: 1,952 LOC form builder with dedicated submissions table, CSV export, honeypot + optional Google reCAPTCHA v3 (disclosed in Third-Party Services), and %i SQL identifier escaping (reduced from 7 PCP warnings to 0).

plugins.name: Gratis Popup
plugins.reviewNotes: Accessible modal/slide-in popups with focus trap, reduced-motion support, frequency caps, and clean block/shortcode rendering without calling core the_content filter.

plugins.name: Gratis Security
plugins.reviewNotes: 15,004 LOC WAF, malware scanner, file integrity monitor, security headers, TOTP 2FA, and 4 passing self-check suites. Third-Party Services added for WordPress.org checksums & optional feeds (reduced from 2 PCP warnings to 0).

plugins.name: Gratis CDN
plugins.reviewNotes: Asset URL rewriting, content-hash fingerprinting, and authenticated Cloudflare/BunnyCDN/KeyCDN/webhook purge with Third-Party Services disclosures and ABSPATH guards.

plugins.name: Gratis Commerce
plugins.reviewNotes: Stripe Checkout with replay-protected HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification plus WooCommerce quick view, wishlist, compare, and AJAX filters. ABSPATH guards and Stripe Third-Party Services disclosure added.

plugins.name: Gratis CRM
plugins.reviewNotes: 1,891 LOC contact manager with broadcast campaigns, unsubscribe tokens, CSV export, and Gratis Forms auto-capture. Note: uses taxonomy slug contact_tag (consider prefixing if requested during review).

plugins.name: Gratis Booking
plugins.reviewNotes: Services/appointments CPTs, configurable business hours & slot intervals, REST slot availability/booking, and email notifications.

plugins.name: Gratis Tables
plugins.reviewNotes: CSV-backed responsive data tables with keyboard-accessible sorting and client-side search.

plugins.name: Gratis Invoice
plugins.reviewNotes: Line-item invoices with auto-recalculated totals, printable HTML output, and multi-currency settings. Header description aligned with src/.

plugins.name: Gratis Learn
plugins.reviewNotes: Courses, ordered lessons, quiz CPT, per-user progress REST endpoint, and outline shortcode.

plugins.name: Gratis Automation
plugins.reviewNotes: Trigger-to-action workflow engine (email, webhook, purge cache, create post, update meta) with ABSPATH guard and Third-Party Services disclosure for user-configured webhooks.

plugins.name: Gratis Affiliate
plugins.reviewNotes: Referral codes, hardened HttpOnly/SameSite attribution cookie, commission tracking, and admin payout tool (reduced from 2 PCP warnings to 0).

plugins.name: Gratis Community
plugins.reviewNotes: Extended user profiles, activity feed CPT/shortcode/REST, groups CPT, and logged-in messaging endpoint.

plugins.name: Gratis Events
plugins.reviewNotes: Events with start/end/venue/capacity/recurrence, RSVP endpoint, and iCal export. Note: uses taxonomy slug event_category.

plugins.name: Gratis Media
plugins.reviewNotes: Media library folders, auto-organize on upload, bulk organizer, and lazy-loaded gallery shortcode. Note: uses taxonomy slug media_folder.

plugins.name: GRATIS Builder
plugins.reviewNotes: 1,877 LOC Gutenberg pattern library, block editing REST API, and AI generation endpoint with rate limiting. All 8 pattern files ABSPATH-guarded. Note: uses listing_category/listing_location taxonomies.

plugins.name: Gratis Access
plugins.reviewNotes: Tiered post/page content restriction with admin grant tool and WP-CLI. Removed unimplemented drip/per-section claims from readme.txt and header. Note: uses taxonomy slug access_level.

plugins.name: Gratis Project
plugins.reviewNotes: Projects & tasks CPTs, MetaBox, and read-only Kanban board shortcode. Note: uses taxonomy slug task_status.

plugins.name: Gratis Translate
plugins.reviewNotes: Multilingual content linking, accessible language switcher, and hreflang tags. Note: uses taxonomy slug language (reviewers may recommend prefixing to gratis_language).

plugins.name: Gratis Fleet
plugins.reviewNotes: 1,527 LOC multi-site manager. Hardened: fixed arbitrary do_action injection in WebhookHub::receive, cached DB size query, removed all 4 sslverify=false flags, added ABSPATH guards & Third-Party Services disclosures, removed competitor pricing copy (reduced from 3 PCP warnings to 0).

plugins.name: Gratis AI
plugins.reviewNotes: BYOM OpenAI-compatible AI router, encrypted key vault, MCP server (hardened input sanitization), and Abilities API integration. Remaining 4 PCP warnings are informational WP 7.0 AIProvider.DirectIntegration advisories for provider endpoints.

plugins.name: Gratis Cache
blockers: Legacy 3-char vlt_* prefix across 40+ wp_options, REST namespace (vlt-cache/v1), and AJAX action (vlt_async_worker) requires full prefix migration to gratis_cache_* before WP.org submission.
Defines core SAVEQUERIES and DISABLE_WP_CRON constants inside plugin runtime; dynamic job hook dispatch in AsyncQueue (6 remaining PCP warnings, down from 45).
plugins.reviewNotes: Removed mcp-for-page-builders/v1 arbitrary file/option write endpoints, removed 3 sslverify=false flags, removed 3 set_time_limit(0) calls with 25s SSE bounds, wrapped global $_vlt_* vars in closure, cached stats queries, and added ABSPATH guards to 59 files.

plugins.name: Gratis DB
blockers: DropinManager directly writes/removes wp-content/db.php drop-in files on disk; review WP.org Guideline 8/file-modification requirements.
SlowQueryLog defines WordPress core constant SAVEQUERIES at runtime (1 remaining PCP warning, down from 8).
plugins.reviewNotes: Upgraded Migrator and TableOptimizer to WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping (0 PCP errors) and added ABSPATH guard to DropinManager.

plugins.name: Gratis DevTools
blockers: MigrationManager writes PHP files into wp-content/gratis-migrations/ and executes them via require (high WP.org manual review rejection risk).
DebugBar defines core SAVEQUERIES constant at runtime (1 remaining PCP warning, down from 8); StagingManager uses MySQL-only CREATE TABLE LIKE.
plugins.reviewNotes: Upgraded StagingManager to WP 6.2+ %i SQL identifier escaping, added ABSPATH guards, and removed competitor pricing copy.

plugins.name: Gratis Notify
blockers: Thin stub (98 LOC PushNotifier.php): no real Web Push (no VAPID keys, no Service Worker delivery), front-end script never polls /latest or displays notifications, and /subscribe appends unbounded entries to wp_options without rate limiting.
plugins.reviewNotes: Needs a real notification polling/Web Push delivery implementation before WordPress.org submission.

plugins.name: Gratis Installer
blockers: Not suitable for WordPress.org Plugin Directory (Guidelines 1 & 10): only lists 32 hardcoded juslintek/gratis-* plugins and activates copies already present on disk, with promotional pricing copy and no standalone general-user utility.
plugins.reviewNotes: Keep as a GitHub/direct-download suite helper rather than submitting to wordpress.org.
